semantic.justification: Task AQF9AG maps ScAsciiOptions CSV option parsing to the existing Calc document and file-dialog path. Numeric option tokens use the source o3tl::toInt32 prefix, overflow and narrowing behavior; source defaults, delimiter weighting and surplus-token tolerance are represented. ScImportExport::SetExtOptions copies ScAsciiOptions and its column metadata as the native owned value does. Full formatter-driven date/currency classification, rich edit-text, the native options dialog and the complete text filter remain incomplete and are not claimed as parity. Task AQF9AG preserves UTF-16 code-unit separator serialization and forwards DETECT separators to SfxObjectShell::DetectCsvSeparators with the source stream. BOM probing covers the first phase of source encoding detection; ICU charset guessing remains unrepresented. A present empty option string preserves earlier positional fields while applying the original missing-boolean defaults. The DETECT token invokes the actual source stream encoding detector. Browser transport chooses whether to supply a filter options item at the existing shell boundary.
